lines.text: Peter arrives in Caesarea, where Cornelius meets him and falls at his feet, but Peter helps him up.
Cornelius says a man in radiant clothing told him to send to Joppa for Simon Peter.
Peter says God raised Jesus on the seventh day after they hanged Him on a tree.
While Peter is still speaking, the Holy Spirit falls on all who hear, and the circumcised believers are astounded.
Peter orders them baptized in the name of John the Baptist, and they ask him to stay.
